# Ricky Heidt, San Diego REALTOR®

> Ricky Heidt is a REALTOR® with PorchLight Realty, brokered by eXp Realty of Southern California, Inc. (CA DRE #02230045). He grew up in Carmel Valley, went to Torrey Pines High, and helps people buy, sell and invest across San Diego County, with a focus on Carmel Valley, Del Mar, Solana Beach, Rancho Santa Fe, Poway and Encinitas.

- Phone and text: 858-758-7336
- Email: ricky@porchlightsocal.com
- Office ZIP: 92130 (Carmel Valley, San Diego, CA)
- Website: https://rickyheidt.com/

Market numbers on the neighborhood pages state the month and the source next to each figure (for example, the Greater San Diego Association of REALTORS® local market updates). The site is reviewed twice a month and pages show the month they were last updated.
